name: What are common challenges when renovating a foreclosed property?

mainEntity.name: What are common challenges when renovating a foreclosed property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renovating foreclosed properties often presents unique challenges. These can include unexpected structural damage, hidden issues like mold or pest infestations, and unpermitted previous work. Dealing with utility reconnections, securing the property, and navigating city permit processes can also be complex. A thorough initial inspection and a flexible budget are crucial for addressing these unforeseen problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges include unexpected damage, hidden issues like mold, unpermitted work, and navigating permits and utility reconnections.
